title: H001: Fix README.md project structure accuracy
description:
**Size:** 🔧 small
**Category:** docs
**Priority:** critical
**Source:** Proposed for 'Perform a GAP analysis. The README.md as well as'

Correct the README.md project structure tree (~lines 1912–1945): fix 12 incorrect package names (e.g. internal/mesh→internal/tunnel, internal/observe→internal/metrics, internal/logs→internal/logfwd, internal/audit→internal/auditfwd, internal/access→internal/tunnel, internal/crypto→internal/api verifier), remove 2 phantom directories (pkg/, deploy/docker/ placeholder), add 7 missing packages (fsutil, integrity, kubernetes, metrics, packaging, peerexchange, wireguard), and add missing deploy entries (cloud-init/, install.sh). Remove references to internal/auth, internal/hooks, internal/execution which don't exist as standalone packages.

**Rationale:** README is the primary onboarding document. Currently ~60% of the project structure is wrong — new developers and contributors will be confused by phantom directories and wrong package names. This is ship-blocking for any public/team-facing release.

**Affected Areas:**
- README.md

implementation_notes: This is a documentation-only change to README.md. The project structure tree at lines 1912-1945 needs to be completely replaced. The corrected tree must list all 19 actual internal/ packages (alphabetically): actions, agent, api, auditfwd, bridge, fsutil, integrity, kubernetes, logfwd, metrics, nat, nodeapi, packaging, peerexchange, policy, reconcile, registration, tunnel, wireguard. The deploy/ subtree must show: cloud-init/ (cloud-init templates and Terraform examples), install.sh (installer script), kubernetes/ (DaemonSet manifests, CRDs, RBAC), systemd/ (unit files). The phantom pkg/ and deploy/docker/ entries must be removed. The docs/ entry should show reference/ and how-to/ subdirectories. After editing the tree, scan the rest of README.md for any prose references to the old phantom package names and update them to use the correct package names. Key mapping: mesh→tunnel, observe→metrics, logs→logfwd, audit→auditfwd, access→tunnel (SSH/K8s access proxy is in tunnel package), crypto→api (verifier is in api package). auth, hooks, execution don't exist as standalone packages — their functionality is in api, actions, and actions respectively.
